params.notes: Official hosted Streamable HTTP MCP at https://api.x.com/mcp (search, users, bookmarks, trends, Articles). Read-only: app-only Bearer token from X Developer Console. Full access: OAuth 2.0 PKCE via @xdevplatform/xurl (redirect http://localhost:8080/callback, CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET). Docs: https://x-preview.mintlify.app/tools/mcp. Resume/revise on branch guide/issue-15-x (PR #17). Enrollment and create-app: hedge—no invented console labels; success enrollment = Developer Console with New App visible. API credits: required; point to Developer Console billing/credits without purchase walkthrough. Copy Bearer Token: copy-once only; omit regenerate-if-missed. Speakeasy add-source: catalog search query `X`; keep catalog vs custom remote https://api.x.com/mcp until catalog presence verified.
